# MathScienceDojo

> Online PSLE Maths and Science tuition for Primary 5 and Primary 6 students in Singapore, taught personally by founder Mr Yeo (Yeo Juan Poh) in small live online classes.

## What we do
Teaches PSLE Maths and Science to P5 and P6 students across Singapore, focusing on exam answering technique (keyword-based answers for Science open-ended questions, working presentation for Maths method marks) alongside concept mastery. Small classes so every student's working is reviewed each lesson.

## Who teaches
Every class is taught personally by Mr Yeo, the founder. He has classroom experience teaching primary science (P3–P6) and lower secondary science. There are no rotating tutors.

## Results
Primary 6 Science students have improved from failing or weak grades to strong passes over three to four months, for example 35% to 88%, 42% to 76%, and 53% to 100%.
